case_number: 2024 INSC 340; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 1143 OF 2022, CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 6991-6994 OF 2022
summary: Financial creditor vs operational creditor classification under IBC; agreements dated 1 April 2014 and 1 April 2015 for security deposits with interest @21% per annum; security deposit as financial facility; payment of interest as time value of money; Section 5(8)(f) catch-all provision applied; NCLAT judgment holding respondents as financial creditors upheld; claims rejected by resolution professional; TDS deduction on interest payments; commercial effect of borrowing test applied; sales promotion agreements not rendered operational debt.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.5(7), s.5(8), s.5(21), s.7, s.14, s.60(5)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; NCLAT judgment upholding financial creditor status confirmed.
